tha-ap229:1.1: samattaṃ. [227. Vataṃsakiya.] Uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyanto addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ / vaṭaṃsakaṃ gahetvāna sovaṇṇaṃ sādhunimmitaṃ // //
tha-ap229:2.1: Sīghaṃ tato samārūḷho hatthikkhandhagato ahaṃ / Buddhassa abhiropesiṃ Sikhino lokabandhuno. // //
tha-ap229:3.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap229:4.1: Sattavīse ito kappe eko āsi janādhipo / Mahāpatāpo nāmena cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap229:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Sovaṇṇavataṃsakiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
